title: Surreal Tower with Planets
description: A tall clock tower stands in the center of a green hilly setting with small buildings around its base. Many colorful planets and orbs float in a circular teal space around the tower along with several butterflies and a bat while a large green planet appears behind the tower.
prompt: A tall ornate clock tower stands in the middle of rolling green hills with small buildings at its base. Many colorful spheres and planets of different sizes float in a perfect circular teal space surrounding the tower along with several butterflies and one bat. A large green planet appears directly behind the tower top. The entire scene is contained in a circular frame against a smooth teal to beige gradient background.
